BiblicalUsage: Jamlech is named once, among the princes of Simeon who went out to seek pasture for their flocks. He stands in the list with Meshobab and Joshah, one of the leaders of his tribe.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God records the leaders of small tribes too, and Jamlech is remembered because his people were.
